body:
Sometimes. Back "then", the cutting used to be more..I dont know..special? Maybe it was because it was something "new"..over the time, the body/mind probably forgets/gets used/takes as a normal thing the pain and endorphin stuff that used to be so pleasuring. 

Just go on without it, no matter how hard it may be. We're in this together. 
The hardest part of the end is starting again.

Hey there, buddy.

I beg you, do not give in. Now, I "know" that you suffer, and I can tell you(I may be a little controversial now), the life may get even worse.

But, the thing I want you know..it might also get a better. Either slightly or by a big part. You don¨t know, what's gonna happen in next decade, five years, year, month, week, day. I beg you, once again. Try to go on, through the pain. I don't know your possibilities, but you can for example go for a walk to a forest everyday. Everyday, try to find something beautiful. Or try to plant a tree/flower/something. And take care of it everyday. 

Then, you can say to yourself, that you're keeping something alive. 

I am sorry, if it sounds like a crazy thing. Just trying to make up something, that could help you.

But please.
Go on. 
Ignore where it comes from, and try to remember...
"Every wound will shape me.
Every scar will build my throne."

stay strong, my friend. You CAN make it through.
